phaseA.comparisonLimits: Multi-step forecasts from overlapping windows are serially dependent; about 130 origins; absolute errors are heavy-tailed; a single national series. The Diebold-Mariano test assumes a stationary loss differential, which the 2017 epidemic breaks. Treat both the test and the block-bootstrap interval as rough.

phaseB.proxyStatement: National weekly counts, one week fed as one detector day, are a proxy for the production detector, which runs on daily consultation episodes per district. This tests the rule, not the platform.
